newsitem.title: USA: ITT Educational first-time students up.
newsitem.headline: ITT Educational first-time students up.

text.p: ITT Educational Services Inc said its first-time student enrollment at its ITT Technical Institutes rose 16 percent for the September term.
A total of 7,271 first-time students enrolled in September compared with 6,290 new students in the 1995 term.
ITT added that as of September 30, total student enrollment reached a historic high of 23,971 students, compared with 21,863 students for the same period in 1995, a 10 percent increase.
Re-entering students who had previously withdrawn rose four percent to 880 in September 1996 from 844 in 1995.
The total new student enrollment in the September term was 8,151 students compared with 7,134 students in the 1995 term, a 14 percent increase.

"Our solid gains in first-time students for the September 1996 term marks the fourth consecutive class to enjoy a double-digit increase," Rene Champagne, chairman, said in a statement. "We are particularly pleased with the 13 percent increase in same-college, first-time enrollments."
ITT Educational Services operates 59 ITT Technical Institutes in 26 states.
